checks.check: primary keys unique + enums + NOT NULL + CHECKs (sqlite load)
foreign key integrity (PRAGMA foreign_key_check)
ID formats follow the naming convention
child ids embed their parent id
row counts match requested volume
attempt_ts >= order_ts
received_ts >= event_ts
orders are not earlier than the merchant's onboarded_date
order currency equals merchant settlement currency
expected payout date >= cutoff date
refund never before capture unless labelled REFUND_BEFORE_CAPTURE
refunded <= captured for every order
order status and totals are derived from the canonical events
at most one capture per order
attempt status matches the events (CAPTURED only if a capture event exists)
decline_code is set exactly on declined attempts
fee and refund treatment consistent (fee formula, refunds carry no fee)
batch totals equal the sum of their lines
settlement line amount/currency equals its processor event and batch
duplicate settlement lines are exactly the labelled ones
no settlement line points at a non-canonical event copy
matched amounts reconcile within tolerance (2 minor units)
every settleable event without a line is an exception
every batch without a bank payout is an exception
every unmatched bank line is an exception
every partial or mismatched match row has an exception
resolution exists exactly for closed exceptions
resolved_ts >= detected_at
exception history starts at creation, follows the allowed moves in time order and ends at the current status
every resolution type is allowed for its exception type
ground truth is not referenced by any input table column
